integrity: Universal assertion has an analytic backward-induction proof; finite checks are reproducibility corroboration only. Counterexamples and horizon minimality are proved directly; publication priority is not independently certified.
limitations: Two agents, identical nonnegative additive valuations; main theorem applies to strictly positive common values {1,2} up to uniform scaling and a fixed exogenous arrival order. No extension to heterogeneous agents, arbitrary two-size alphabets, or alternate envy functionals is asserted.
title: Sharp \(\{1,2\}\)-value boundary for foresight-free cumulative envy minimization
